context:
Preserve the current BenchBox-hosted Parquet default unless written permission
or a separate product decision changes the data-delivery model. Treat direct
Dataverse conversion as an explicit advanced/maintainer path because it
preserves canonical source provenance but imposes a poor first-run experience.
description:
Follow-up to `_project/decisions/joinorder-canonical-data-licensing-2026-05-12.md`.
The ADR concluded that BenchBox should not describe its GitHub Release re-host
of `joinorder-imdb-2013-v1.tar.zst` as clearly permitted for broad commercial
redistribution. Harvard Dataverse declares the `imdb_pg11` deposit for DOI
`10.7910/DVN/2QYZBT` as `CC0 1.0`, but IMDb's current dataset terms and the JOB
paper describe the underlying IMDb data as non-commercial and restrict
republishing / repurposing.

The project-owner decision is to accept the residual redistribution risk for
this 2013 academic benchmark dataset and keep the verified BenchBox-hosted
Parquet archive as the default fast path. This TODO is therefore not
release-blocking for canonical `joinorder`; it tracks optional hardening such
as written permission, an explicit direct-Dataverse conversion path, or a
documented BYO-data path.

anti_patterns.dont: make direct Dataverse restore/convert the silent default first-run user experience without separate product approval
modify the canonical query corpus as part of licensing hardening
remove the current fast Parquet path in this TODO unless the replacement UX is explicitly accepted
silently weaken the canonical data contract to avoid a heavy first run

work_units.notes:

counts and hashes. Cache under BenchBox's normal data directory. Do not
make this heavy restore/convert path the silent first-run default without a
separate product decision. Do not change the 113 canonical queries or the
